About Me

Bridging Hardware & Software

Electronics Engineering student with hands-on experience in Embedded Systems, Internet of Things (IoT), Robotics, FPGA development, and Full-Stack Software Development through academic and project-based learning activities. Experienced in designing electronic circuits and custom PCBs using Altium Designer, including schematic capture, PCB layout, manual fabrication, and component soldering. Proficient in Arduino and ESP32 programming for automation, monitoring, and control systems, with experience integrating sensors, RFID, GPS, and various communication modules.

Skilled in developing end-to-end hardware and software solutions, including firmware development, web applications, REST API integration, database management using MySQL/phpMyAdmin, and Linux VPS administration. Familiar with web hosting, cloud-based deployments, reverse proxy configuration, server management, and system monitoring. Possess practical knowledge of networking concepts, router technologies, and infrastructure deployment for connected systems.

Successfully contributed to multiple projects including the development of a custom H-Bridge motor driver and sensor module for line follower robots, hydroponic temperature and humidity monitoring systems using ESP32 and web dashboards, RFID-based smart lockers integrated with Tripay Payment Gateway, FPGA-based smart parking systems utilizing RFID and infrared sensors, and GPS-enabled animal tracking platforms featuring geofencing and real-time notifications through Gmail, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp.

Demonstrated ability to bridge electronics, embedded programming, networking, and software engineering by delivering complete solutions from hardware design and firmware development to backend services, database systems, and cloud deployment. Passionate about software development, embedded technologies, networking, router systems, self-hosted infrastructure, and continuous learning in emerging technologies related to automation, IoT, and intelligent systems.
